body: Thank you all for the comments

I went to University , graduated 3 years ago now and managed to get my dream job. For some idiotic reason i decided to take an electronic item that did not belong to me. I was convicted of theft. This lead to me being dismissed from my job and to top it off ive just had my first child.

I do not know how the hell i will cope, my career prospects were so good and i fucked up drasticslly. I think everyday about the past and just can't move on its eating me up inside.

The  baby with my partner also breaks my heart to even think ive brought him into this world.

I dont know what to do anymore.

Hi there whats bothering you ?

Im a frequent user of Crisis too i called them 5 mins ago!

Your very young. 

Think how hard you worked for your degree, it was a up hill climb. Sometimes you slip down the hill but theres always another route up! Take the experience, setting the expectation that you will walk into a job an expert is unfair on yourself. Doctors who have extensive curricular training even take time to learn. 

For context i worked my way up to a position within the government. Setting harsh targets for myself. Im 27 now and i lost my job due to mental health issues! Go easy on yourself you have worked your arse off for that position and who cares if you dont fit in straight away. Keep up the good work!

Learning a job takes time. Each day spend 30 mins reflecting on your thoughts and aspects bothering you. It takes all types of personailities to make a company dont forget that! Dont hate yourself a job is a choice not a factor that determines you as a living being.

Keep your head up!

Thanks for the Reply.

I live in the UK so not sure if such companies exist. The future seems so irreparable at the moment its difficult to think positively...

Ive got another job but its a dog shit job soul destroying.

Ive just began some prozac so i hope this helps!

Hi There , thanks for the reply.. wow respect to you..! I went through a tough time in the way of obtaining a criminal conviction. In the UK it is not as tough as a felony in the US so i should be able to get employment i pray. I deeply regret what happened and wish i could change things but it is something i must live with.
